widgetTool.name: epp_plans
widgetTool.description: Emit instalment plan options for a selected EPP-eligible purchase. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you the instalment options.' Webchat only — on voice, read plan details aloud.

confirm_cta_label.description: Label for the primary confirm button, e.g. 'Continue with 12 months'.

confirm_cta_value.description: Sent back to the agent on confirm, e.g. 'epp_plan_confirm:12'.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'epp_plans'

plans.description: Required. Tenure options. Interest rate is passed for regulatory disclosure and rendered as a small footnote line, never as a headline.

interest_rate_pct.description: Annual interest rate, e.g. 1.5. Displayed only inside the 'Plan details' disclosure, never in the primary chip.

monthly_amount_cad.description: Amount charged each month. The headline figure on the chip.

recommended.description: If true, the chip is highlighted as the default choice.

total_repayable_cad.description: Sum of all monthly payments. Shown as a subtle grey figure in expanded 'Plan details'.

product_id.description: Chosen product id from the carousel step.

retail_price_cad.description: Retail price shown small under the product name.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
